text:
incident-bot: Pager alert — infer-runner-us-west-2: 5xx rate increased to 9.8% over baseline. Autoscale triggered. Runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/infer-5xx
alex_sre: I'm on it :rotating_light: checking logs and routing
maria_runtime: possible segfaults in quant-kernel from recent patch, saw coredumps on node infer-03
alex_sre: can you paste the stacktrace if you have it?
dave_ops: found repeated stacktrace in journalctl on infer-03:
```text
[   45.123456] infer-runner[2345]: segfault at 0 ip 00007f... sp 00007ff...
#0 0x7f... quant_kernel::run
#1 0x7f... model_runner::forward
#2 0x7f... worker_loop
...
```
maria_runtime: same, plus OOM killer logs pointing to renderer process: "oom_reaper invoked"
sam_oncall: re-routing to fallback model-compat-v1 now. Will scale up dedicated pool by +2 to shed load. @alex_sre please coordinate
alex_sre: running routing change: `rdctl route add --from infer-prod --to infer-fallback --lift=0.07`
lina_support: customer impact: 4 tenants reporting 502s, mostly SLO tier customers. Notified CSMs and posted interim status to status.redwood.ai
maria_runtime: quick mitigation: revert quant-kernel patch, PR ready https://git/redwood/merge/456 — need a fast rollback to v2.3.1
alex_sre: initiating canary rollback on 10% traffic, then full if green. Post the canary logs when available
pager-bot: metrics snapshot: error rate spike from 1.2% -> 9.8% at 12:03 UTC; after routing change dropped to 3.5% by 12:12 UTC. https://metrics.internal/graphs/abcd
sam_oncall: canary shows 0 segfaults in 15m, proceeding to full rollback :white_check_mark:
alex_sre: rollback complete, scaling down extra pool in 10m. continuing to monitor
maria_runtime: follow-up: we will cut a hotfix that adds bounds checks to quant-kernel and run extended regression on longseqs. PR link above, will request QA run
lina_support: filing customer incident updates now. ETA for full RCA & postmortem by EOD
alex_sre: thanks team. leaving this thread open for 1h for monitoring; escalate if spikes resume :thumbsup:
